evidence_state: Evidence was generated against the immutable implementation commit or the worktree/index based on that commit plus only authorized remediation changes and authorized evidence-finalization changes; each entry identifies its exact state.
containing_commit_binding: This manifest is committed in the Git commit that contains this manifest. The containing commit hash is intentionally not embedded.
self_reference_limitation: Embedding the containing commit or requiring a Full guard transcript to validate its own final hash would be self-referential. Full guard runs skip only their own changing transcript hash; staged evidence records its pre-final capture point.
independent_audit_requirement: An independent audit must obtain the containing commit from Git and verify its parent, branch, scope, manifest content, referenced hashes, and final clean synchronized status.
historical_binary_limitation: The earlier implementation-checkpoint binaries are no longer available for independent byte or semantic comparison, so their exact equivalence to later binaries cannot be retroactively proven. Their hashes remain historical observations only; acceptance now relies on the retained source-identical A/B rebuild.

ab_rebuild_contract.normalization_justification: A/B normalized equality is obtained only by zeroing linker timestamps, the derived PE checksum, debug-directory timestamps, and the per-build CodeView GUID. Executable-section bytes, imports, normalized disassembly, normalized symbols, retention boundaries, target/request absence, and Authenticode state are equal without exclusion.

status_mapping.framework_status_rule: Returned only for the four creation-failure results and only when failing.

binary_inspection.rebuild_note: Set B is the final canonical candidate. A/B raw hashes differ, but only named nondeterministic metadata differs; normalized PE, executable sections, imports, disassembly, symbols, retention, target/request absence, and Authenticode state are equal.
